source_name: Törvényfigyelő – társadalmi egyeztetésre bocsátott jogszabálytervezetek
why_relevant: Independent Hungarian legislation-tracking aggregator that consolidates draft laws out for public consultation in one list — a native-language substitute for the commercial horizon-scanning trackers, and a cross-check that nothing was quietly posted and pulled from the government portal.

source_name: EBA Interactive Single Rulebook
why_relevant: Article-level compendium tying CRR/CRD level-1 text to RTS/ITS, EBA guidelines and Q&As. The fastest way to establish, for any prudential obligation binding a Hungarian bank, the full stack of level 2/3 material and its application dates.

source_name: ESMA Interactive Single Rulebook
why_relevant: Same function as the EBA tool for securities/markets files (MiFID II/MiFIR, MiCA-adjacent); relevant to the investment-services side of Hungarian banks.

source_name: KPMG Hungary – Financial Risk & Regulation hírlevél
why_relevant: Big-4 Hungarian-language regulatory newsletter series (FRR) that summarises MNB and EU developments for HU financial institutions, with interpretation and implementation timelines. Useful as a curated horizon-scanning digest and as a signal of what practitioners consider material. Archive of past issues is browsable.

source_name: Lexology – Hungary banking & financial regulation feed
why_relevant: Aggregates Hungarian and international law-firm alerts on HU banking/payments rules; in practice the fastest English-language early warning on HU legislative moves (e.g. crypto/MiCA alignment bills, cyber decrees) with citation back to the primary instrument.

source_name: CEE Legal Matters – Hungary desk
why_relevant: Regional legal-news aggregator with a Hungary section; good for actor mapping (which firms/advisers work on which regulatory files) and for catching regulatory changes framed as deal/market news.

source_name: Vixio RegTech horizon-scanning platform (commercial)
why_relevant: Commercial regulatory-change monitoring covering 140+ jurisdictions and 1,400+ authorities, payments-focused. Relevant as a benchmark for what a paid HU feed would deliver, and as a potential licensed shortcut — but it is a vendor claim, not a verified HU-coverage fact.

source_name: FinregE regulatory horizon-scanning platform (commercial)
why_relevant: Second commercial horizon-scanning vendor with published methodology material (obligation mapping, alerting on effective dates). Its public guides are a usable template for designing our own HU deadline tracker even if we never buy the product.

source_name: NKI (Nemzeti Kiberbiztonsági Intézet) RSS csatornák
why_relevant: Hungarian national cybersecurity institute's RSS endpoints. Adjacent-but-material to banking supervision because DORA/NIS2 implementation and HU cyber decrees (e.g. the 2026 cybersecurity amendment reported by law firms) create binding deadlines for financial entities.

source_name: kormany.hu Dokumentumtár – Jogszabálytervezetek, filtered to Nemzetgazdasági Minisztérium
why_relevant: The ministry-scoped draft-legislation shelf of the government document repository. Search snippets indicate ~130 NGM entries under the draft-law category, each bundling summary (előterjesztés), normative text, indokolás and impact assessment, plus a stated comment deadline and a comment mailbox (e.g. kozigazgatasiegyeztetes@ngm.gov.hu). NGM is the ministry owning financial-sector, tax and payments legislation.

source_name: kormany.hu Dokumentumtár – Társadalmi egyeztetés collection page
why_relevant: Cross-ministry landing entries in the document archive holding consultation packages with the standard cover sheet 'Jogszabálytervezet/jogszabály címe – A társadalmi egyeztetés formájának ...' that records consultation form, commenters and deadline.

source_name: kormany.hu Hírek (government news) – consultation launch announcements
why_relevant: Ministries announce the opening of a consultation as a news item ('Társadalmi egyeztetés kezdődött ...'), which is often the fastest timestamped signal and links straight to the draft package. Useful as a trigger feed even when the repository listing lags.

source_name: Nemzetgazdasági Minisztérium (NGM) – ministry pages and contact/elérhetőségek
why_relevant: NGM is the executive owner of financial-sector, payments and tax legislation in the current government structure (successor of the Pénzügyminisztérium's economic policy functions). Its contact and organisational pages identify the state secretariats and the administrative-consultation mailbox (kozigazgatasiegyeztetes@ngm.gov.hu) through which comment deadlines are addressed.

source_name: cdn.kormany.hu document attachment store
why_relevant: All draft texts, indokolás, impact assessments and consultation summary sheets attached to kormany.hu pages are served from this CDN under hashed paths. It is the actual payload layer for any A3 draft-bill collection.

source_name: 2010. évi CXXXI. törvény (Jet.) – law on public participation in law-making
why_relevant: Defines the legal obligation, the forms of consultation (általános / közvetlen egyeztetés), what must be published, and the minimum comment window — the rulebook that tells a collector what SHOULD exist, so absence of a draft is itself a signal.

source_name: 301/2010. (XII. 23.) Korm. rendelet – publication and commenting of draft legislation and regulatory concepts
why_relevant: Implementing decree governing where and how drafts (jogszabálytervezetek, szabályozási koncepciók) must be published and commented on — defines the metadata a monitoring pipeline can rely on.

source_name: 1352/2022. (VII. 21.) Korm. határozat – government decision on the legislative/administrative coordination workflow
why_relevant: Sets the internal közigazgatási egyeztetés timetable — comments due within five working days of receipt, extendable, with the Prime Minister's Office administrative state secretary able to set up to thirty working days. Explains how compressed real-world comment windows on financial-sector drafts are, which drives how frequently the pipeline must poll.

source_name: Országgyűlés – Irományok lekérdezése / Folyamatban lévő törvényjavaslatok
why_relevant: Downstream endpoint of the executive pipeline: once a ministry draft is submitted as a bill (T/xxxxx iromány) it appears here with full text PDF, submitter ministry and amendment trail. Confirms which consulted drafts survived and how the text changed.

source_name: Magyar Bankszövetség (Hungarian Banking Association) – working groups, quarterly reports, positions
why_relevant: The industry body is a named participant in közigazgatási/társadalmi egyeztetés on banking drafts. Its working-group structure and quarterly reports (negyedéves jelentés PDFs) narrate which ministry drafts were under consultation in a period and what the sector objected to — often revealing drafts never prominently published.

source_name: EU TRIS – Technical Regulation Information System, Hungary notifications
why_relevant: Hungary must notify draft technical rules (including many affecting payment terminals, e-invoicing, cash-register/online till and IT-service requirements) to the Commission before adoption, triggering a three-month standstill. This exposes HU ministry drafts in English, with dates, sometimes earlier and more machine-readably than the national portal.

source_name: Közadatkereső / kozadat public-data search (linked from kormany.hu footer)
why_relevant: National public-interest-data catalogue referenced from the kormany.hu document archive footer; a route to ministry datasets and publication schemes that may index draft-legislation and consultation records not surfaced by the portal's own filters.

source_name: kormany.hu archive generations (2010-2014 / 2015-2019 / 2020-2025)
why_relevant: Each government cycle's site is frozen at a dated subdomain retaining old draft-legislation listings and — in the older generations — explicit RSS channel indexes. Essential for backfilling the consultation history of financial-sector rules and for resolving links that 404 on the current site.

source_name: Jogászvilág / Jogi Fórum / jogkodex – legal-professional press on consultation practice
why_relevant: Legal trade press reports on which draft bills went to consultation, how often consultation is skipped, and the practical meaning of short deadlines — context that calibrates how much weight to put on the absence of a published draft.

source_name: NGM administrative-consultation mailbox (kozigazgatasiegyeztetes@ngm.gov.hu)
why_relevant: The address published on NGM draft packages for submitting comments; its presence in a document is a reliable machine-detectable marker that an item is a live NGM consultation with a deadline, and it identifies NGM as the responsible ministry for a draft.

source_name: MNB Felügyeleti hírek – hírek, újdonságok (EU-jogi és ESA-hírfolyam magyarul)
why_relevant: Ez az a csatorna, ahol az MNB magyarul, folyamatosan közli az EBA/ESMA/EIOPA/ESA és bizottsági fejleményeket (DORA RTS/ITS, konzultációk, ütemtervek) és jelzi a hazai alkalmazási következményeket. Gyakorlatilag az EU-réteg magyar 'fordítója' és a hazai határidők első bejelentési helye.

source_name: MNB Vezetői körlevelek
why_relevant: A körlevél az a gyors csatorna, amelyen az MNB konkrét megfelelési elvárást és határidőt közöl az intézmények vezetőivel — gyakran egy frissen alkalmazandó EU-szabály (DORA, IPR, MiCA) kapcsán, még ajánlás kiadása előtt.

source_name: MNB ERA – DORA adatszolgáltatási felületek (Információ-nyilvántartás / incidensbejelentés) és kézikönyvek
why_relevant: Az ERA-felület és kézikönyvei mutatják meg, hogy a DORA EU-szintű kötelezettségei OPERATÍVAN hogyan csapódnak le Magyarországon: regisztrációs kötelezettség, beküldési formátum, konkrét adatszolgáltatási határidők. Erős korai jelzés a bankok tényleges terhelésére.
